name: Layout Builder Kit
description: A set of seven ready-made block components (Rich Text, Image, Icon Text, Video, Render, Tab, Book Navigation) for building pages with core Layout Builder.

suggests.book: Required by the Book Navigation (LBK) component.
suggests.media: Required by the Render (LBK) component to render media entities.
suggests.drupal/layout_builder_modal: Recommended for a better editing experience when configuring components.

project_description: Layout Builder Kit is a set of pre-made block components you can use in your Layout Builder (or Block Layout) pages. Version 3 works on Drupal 10+ and requires Hook Event Dispatcher 4.x. The module provides seven components — Book Navigation, Icon Text, Image, Render, Rich Text, Tab and Video — each implemented as a core @Block plugin whose id is prefixed 'lbk_' and whose admin label ends in '(LBK)'. It provides no @Layout plugins and no section styles; it is a component/block library, not a section framework. Each component shares a common configuration surface (a Title, a 'Display title' checkbox and a free-text 'CSS class' field) supplied by the module's LBKBaseComponent base class. Components register their Twig templates at runtime through the Hook Event Dispatcher theme event, which is why the module depends on hook_event_dispatcher. The module's own settings form (image upload location and allowed image extensions) lives at /admin/config/content/layout_builder_kit/settings and is gated by the 'access layout builder kit components' permission. The project is minimally maintained with no further development planned; the maintainer recommends evaluating alternative page builders.
